statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed; hawkish rates, Gulf-market weakness and geopolitical uncertainty keep Stress extreme ahead of the Sunday reopen.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The principal conditional WATCH interval is concentrated in the first three Globex reopening hours, with escalation dependent on actual gap persistence and failed retracements.
headline: Low Tail before Globex; extreme Stress remains concentrated into the reopening window
body: NQ remains closed before the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen. Friday's hawkish Fed repricing and Sunday Gulf weakness remain material; fresh supplementary latest-session evidence shows weak semiconductors but mixed-positive megacaps, not live NQ price-path proof.

lookbackSummary: From Aug. 29 19:00 UTC through Aug. 30 18:00 UTC, published ChatGPT assessments kept Tail at 19% in normal mode. Stress rose from 78% to 82% as reopening risk accumulated; confidence remained 94-95%.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low before the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen, then rises conditionally into WATCH for the first three reopening hours. Gap persistence, shallow or failed retracements, repeated extension and session-extreme holding are the escalation tests; two-sided discovery would weaken Tail quickly.

forecast.analysis: With about two hours to Globex, reopening uncertainty remains elevated. Tail stays low unless a future abnormal gap is followed by shallow or failed retracements.
In the final pre-open hour, gap uncertainty is concentrated. A large gap alone would raise Stress; persistent extension after weak retracements would be needed to lift Tail.
At the Globex reopen, WATCH is conditional on the realized gap, first-retracement depth and repeated extension after failed counter-moves. Two-sided discovery would weaken Tail quickly.
The second reopening hour has the peak conditional Tail score. One-way extension, shallow pullbacks and session-extreme holding would sustain WATCH; successful retracements would not.
The third reopening hour remains WATCH only if early directional efficiency persists. Broader retracement, volatility decay or cross-asset conflict would reduce the Tail case.
After the principal reopening window, Tail returns below WATCH absent continuing mean-reversion failure. Stress can remain high while rates and geopolitical risks stay unresolved.
Later in the Asian session, persistent one-way structure would still matter, but it is not assumed. Without repeated extension, Tail remains low as Stress eases.
As Asia matures, orderly price discovery would permit further Stress normalization. Any renewed directional acceleration would require fresh observed confirmation to change Tail.
Near the Asia-Europe handoff, cross-assets may become more informative. Tail remains low unless NQ actually holds near an extreme with shallow pullbacks and aligned confirmation.
Early European hours may reprice rates, currencies and geopolitics. Future alignment is not assumed; Tail stays low unless NQ develops persistent directional efficiency.
European price discovery should show whether any Sunday gap has been absorbed. Meaningful retracements support low Tail; failed retracements plus renewed extension would challenge it.
With Europe active, yields, semiconductors and megacaps become useful confirmation or conflict checks. Cross-asset alignment alone would not prove a pathological NQ path.
Late European morning can strengthen liquidity and directional conviction. Tail remains below WATCH unless a future NQ trend is persistent and resists meaningful counter-moves.
Into the U.S. premarket, rates and technology leadership become more relevant. Stress edges higher, but premarket event risk alone is not evidence of failed mean reversion.
Two hours before the cash open, positioning and macro sensitivity may widen swings. Tail stays low unless persistent NQ continuation is actually observed.
drivers: Two hours to U.S. cash open

forecast.analysis: One hour before the cash open, headline and rate sensitivity increase. An abnormal premarket trend with repeated failed retracements would be the main escalation test.
drivers: One hour to U.S. cash open

forecast.analysis: In the final pre-open phase, Stress rises as liquidity and positioning build. Tail stays low unless future price action shows persistent efficiency rather than ordinary volatility.
The U.S. cash-open hour is a high-information checkpoint. Shallow pullbacks, repeated extension and session-extreme holding would be required before Tail should rise.
The Dallas Fed survey arrives during the post-open hour. Its result may affect rates and volatility, but the event itself raises Stress more than Tail absent a one-way price path.
After Dallas Fed, two-sided discovery would allow Stress to ease. A delayed directional second leg would require fresh evidence before it could justify higher Tail.
By mid-session, the base case assumes no persistent mean-reversion failure. Tail stays low while markets digest rates, technology leadership and geopolitical developments.
Later U.S. trading should clarify whether the opening move was durable. Without repeated extension and extreme-holding behavior, Tail remains low and Stress moderates.
At the late forecast horizon, the base case remains low Tail with declining Stress. Any renewed one-way move would need contemporaneous NQ and cross-asset confirmation.
